name: Menu
description: Command menu: apps, triggers, style, setup, install, update, about and power, from default/menu.jsonc plus ~/.config/haseen/menu.jsonc

width.description: Card width in px at the default font size (Omarchy's 300); Capture › Screenrecord and Style › Font open at 520

placement.description: Where the menu opens: overlay (Omarchy's: a card centred over the dimmed screen), center (a panel in the middle of the screen) or bar (a panel under the bar)

debugIpc.description: Test hook: expose IPC target haseen.menu (select, back, accept, search, state) to drive the open menu without a keyboard
